column1: # 马里奥赛车 8 豪华版（Switch，基础版 1.0.0 与更新 4.0.1）的游戏档案。
# Game profile of Mario Kart 8 Deluxe (Switch, base game 1.0.0 and update 4.0.1).
# 状态 | Status: SURVEY ONLY -- no shader tables yet, so the NSP script still
# refuses to build an IPA for this title.  Everything below was measured by
# `scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py` on this title's own NSPs (see the survey it
# 格式：键 <TAB> 值 | Format: key <TAB> value
# 基础版 1.0.0 的 main 构建号未单独测量：粗查用的是更新里的四个模块。
# The base 1.0.0 main build ID was not measured separately: the survey read the
# four modules out of the update.
# 着色器表尚未生成，故为空；NSP 脚本读到空值会在打包前停下并给出提示。
# No shader tables yet, hence empty; the NSP script stops before packaging.
# 除 main / sdk 外还有 subsdk0（NintendoSDK_NVN），装载顺序 main、subsdk*、sdk。
# Besides main / sdk there is subsdk0 (NintendoSDK_NVN); load order main, subsdk*, sdk.
# 应用池取 Switch 4 GB 机型的 3285 MiB，与其它档案一致；nninitStartup 请求
# 0xc1c00000（池减去模块占用），实测 SetHeapSize 在该容量下成功。
# The application pool is the 3285 MiB of a 4 GB Switch, as in every other
# profile; nninitStartup asks for 0xc1c00000 (the pool minus the module
# footprint) and SetHeapSize succeeds at that capacity (measured).
# ---- 尚未确定 | Not yet determined ----
